# User garment export evidence

Original user-supplied `.dress` JSON, gzip-compressed without modification (mtime=0).
Source names/hashes are in `docs/research/2026-11-09-history-context.json`.
These contain user design state and asset references, no game assets/assemblies.

`commission-labelled` does **not** describe the paired Chilly Overtime capture;
its shape matches record 9 Pigeon Adoption. Do not treat the upload label as a
verified image/state/quest training association. The other two exports match their
captured shapes/counts, without proving complete state identity.
